accounts_user_id_is_wallet_owner.name: accounts_user_id_is_wallet_owner
accounts_user_id_is_wallet_owner.value: ("accounts"."kind" = 'user_wallet') = ("accounts"."user_id" is not null) and ("accounts"."user_id" is null or "accounts"."user_id" = "accounts"."owner_ref")

accounts_normal_side_by_kind.name: accounts_normal_side_by_kind
accounts_normal_side_by_kind.value:
"accounts"."normal_side" = (case "accounts"."kind"
        when 'user_wallet' then 'credit'
        when 'contest_escrow' then 'credit'
        when 'sponsor_funding' then 'debit'
        when 'promo_liability' then 'credit'
        when 'platform_fee' then 'credit'
        when 'external_settlement' then 'debit'
      end)::ledger_side

accounts_owner_ref_by_kind.name: accounts_owner_ref_by_kind
accounts_owner_ref_by_kind.value:
case "accounts"."kind"
        when 'user_wallet' then "accounts"."owner_ref" is not null and "accounts"."owner_ref" ~ '^usr_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        when 'contest_escrow' then "accounts"."owner_ref" is not null and "accounts"."owner_ref" ~ '^cnt_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        else true
      end

api_keys_key_prefix_shape.name: api_keys_key_prefix_shape
api_keys_key_prefix_shape.value:
"api_keys"."key_prefix" ~ '^(sk|pk)_(sandbox|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$'
        and "api_keys"."key_prefix" like (case "api_keys"."kind" when 'secret' then 'sk_' else 'pk_' end) || "api_keys"."environment"::text || '_%'

idempotency_keys_scope_shape.name: idempotency_keys_scope_shape
idempotency_keys_scope_shape.value:
("idempotency_keys"."scope" = 'service' and "idempotency_keys"."result" is not null and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_body" is null)
        or ("idempotency_keys"."scope" = 'http' and "idempotency_keys"."result" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" between 100 and 599 and "idempotency_keys"."response_body" is not null)

operator_flags_reviewed_pair.name: operator_flags_reviewed_pair
operator_flags_reviewed_pair.value: ("operator_flags"."status" = 'open') = ("operator_flags"."reviewed_at" is null) and ("operator_flags"."reviewed_at" is null) = ("operator_flags"."reviewed_by" is null)

user_verification_reverify_needs_verifie.name: user_verification_reverify_needs_verified
user_verification_reverify_needs_verifie.value: "user_verification"."reverify_after" is null or "user_verification"."verified_at" is not null
